chosen_because: best of the Productive estate on both halves of the funnel: 13.6% of requests accepted (129 of 951) and 17.8% of accepted replied (23 of 129). OMEGA 2 has more volume - 15,770 requests - and converts worse on both: 10.7% accepted, 13.5% of accepted replied.
